features.title: Catalog loader

features.title: Poll loop + once mode
features.user_visible_behavior: --once runs one cycle exit 0; --loop repeats on the interval and survives per-cycle errors.
verification: Unit/CLI: --once with fakes exits 0.
Code inspection: loop wraps cycles in try/except and sleeps the interval.
evidence: tests/test_loop.py: --once exits 0 with failing boards; loop wraps cycles in try/except and sleeps the interval (code-inspected by FCAR).

features.title: Proxy-truncation retry (UPHILL first)
features.user_visible_behavior: A board fetch cut short by IncompleteRead / remote-closed retries on a fresh connection, max 2 retries, same 20s timeout and polite delay; a board still failing after retries is a normal board failure, never a partial posting, never a cycle abort.
verification: Unit: fake transport raising IncompleteRead twice then succeeding -> posting fetched, retry count recorded.
Unit: fake transport always raising IncompleteRead -> board failure recorded, cycle continues, no partial posting queued.
features.notes: v2, 2026-10-25: hardest feature first per BUILDER-OS unknown-first-sorter. Live evidence: Kantiv/Composio Ashby IncompleteRead failures in the last live cycles.

features.title: Dead-board quarantine
features.user_visible_behavior: A board 404ing for 3 consecutive cycles is quarantined: skipped by --once polls, listed in --audit with its consecutive-404 count. Quarantine never deletes a catalog entry or touches the seen-list; re-check only via --include-quarantined or a catalog edit.
verification: Unit: fake catalog with a board 404ing 3 cycles -> 4th cycle skips it and reports it quarantined.
Unit: quarantine state survives a reload; --include-quarantined re-polls the board.
features.notes: v2, 2026-10-25. Live evidence: ~45-48 failed boards/cycle, dominated by unverified-slug 404s (Darwinbox, Setu, Superkalam, Angel One on wrong platforms).

features.title: On-demand audit report
features.user_visible_behavior: --audit prints one JSON report: boards ok/failed/quarantined in the last cycle, last-cycle timestamp and counts, queue depth, triage_unavailable count. Read-only apart from reading state files; no loop, no cron, no background process.
verification: Unit/CLI: fixture state dir -> --audit JSON parses and reports the fixture counts exactly.
Unit/CLI: --audit with missing state files reports empty/unknown, exit 0, no crash.
features.notes: v2, 2026-10-25. This is the report main/other chats use to decide on a --once run under the no-new-schedules rule.
